note: The 3 Amharic narration lines (+ English) used as the experiment's source text, taken from the development storyboard v7. The matching Amharic audio is in audio/am_*.wav.

s03.narration: የቡናው ጢስ ሲወጣ፣ መጥሪያ ደወል አያስፈልገውም።
s03.subtitle: When the roasted smoke rises, no words are needed to call us.

s07.narration: ቶና ሲደገም፣ የታሪኩ ፈትል ወደ ታናናሾቹ ይሻገራል።
s07.subtitle: With Tona, the thread of memory passes gently to younger hands.

s10.narration: በየትኛውም ምድር ብንኖር፣ ይሄ የቤታችን እና የትውስታችን ጠረን ነው።
s10.subtitle: Wherever we are in the world, this is what home smells like.
